title: Uniform convergence and isogeny invariance of renormalized Fargues polygons for finitely presented Breuil–Kisin–Fargues modules over perfectoid extensions of p-adic fields
author: Christophe Cornut; Macarena Peche Irissarry
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 2 (2019), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.22

difficulty_reason: The author constructs a renormalized Harder–Narasimhan polygon on a non-Noetherian integral p-adic category and proves uniform convergence through quasi-abelian torsion dévissage, polygon inequalities and isogeny error control. This integral p-adic Hodge mechanism exceeds ordinary qualifying algebra and geometry.
